question: Approve the spec for the Reports month picker (MonthPickerModal as a new sibling component, 13 ACs with proposed offline/interactive proof) to proceed to build?

artifacts.summary: Spec resolves ideation's four open questions: MonthPickerModal ships as a NEW SIBLING component to DatePickerModal (not a mode prop) to protect DatePickerModal's four-site pinned 26-AC suite; reuses year/month as plain numbers matching Reports' own state; exposes the same tap-title year-list flow DatePickerModal already has; and the Monthly trigger button supplements (not replaces) the existing prev/next chevrons. Annual view gets no analogous control. Design is grounded in a direct, line-cited read of DatePickerModal.tsx, reports/page.tsx, and both locale files. Risk evidence: no spike needed — every mechanism (portal+stopPropagation guard, local-calendar-part arithmetic, year-list range/selection) is reused verbatim from DatePickerModal's already-proven, already-tested code; the one new piece (bare year stepping) is a strict subset of DatePickerModal's existing year-view arithmetic. 13 ACs: AC-1 through AC-11 offline (jsdom render-test harness, new month-picker.render.test.js), AC-12/AC-13 interactive (staging live drive) — each with Verified by/Falsified by clauses. AC-10 pins DatePickerModal itself unmodified; AC-8 pins Annual unchanged.
